title: Umufasha adanyiganyiga mu kigeragezo c'inzahabu
intro: Mu gitutu c’umuhanuzi akomeye, umutima w’ubuhinga bwo kuvuga neza n’ukwizera waratowe kugira ngo ufashe mu butumwa buhambaye cane. Uwo mubare warahagaze ushikamye igihe abantu benshi bagenda bahungabana, bamamaza barwanya icaha gitomoye cari giteye ubwoba umushinge nyawo w’ugusenga Imana imwe. Igihe uwo muhanuzi yasubira kwibonera ukuntu abantu bacitse intege, ivyo uwo mubare yari yiregura ntivyari ivyo kwicira urubanza ahubwo vyari ivyo kwiregura n’ugutinya amacakubiri. Uwo musuku wa Allah yihebeye ni nde?
clues: Natowe na Allah ku gikorwa ceranda iruhande y’uwundi, kandi uruhara rwanje rwari urwo gushigikira no kwamamaza.
Nararonse uburenganzira bwo kuvuga neza, kandi naraherekejwe n’intumwa kugira ngo nhangane n’umunyaruyeri w’inkomezi.
Mu rugendo ruhambaye, iyo ntumwa yaraduze umusozi yonyene, ansiga kugira ngo ndabe abantu.
Igihe batahari, abantu barahingura igishushanyo c’inzahabu, nanje ndabinginga ngo bagume ari intahemuka, ariko banka impanuro yanje.
Intumwa igarutse, yuzuye ishavu n’agahinda, narafashwe, ariko ndabasigurira ko nari naraneshejwe kandi ko mfise ubwoba bwo gutuma haba amacakubiri.
Ndi umuhanuzi yahagaze iruhande ya Musa, mwenewacu, asangira umuzigo wiwe, aguma ashikamye ku bijanye n’ugusenga ibigirwamana.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Abantu barasenga inyana y’inzahabu naho bari baragabishijwe .
Narakuwe mu gisagara cacu kubera kwamamaza .

outcome.answer: Nararekuwe maze ndabandanya igikorwa canje c'ubuhanuzi .

verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
